fixtures.what_it_pins: tpr64 matches one-thread-per-row oracle; illegal geometry is refused
tg not a whole number of rows is refused; per-row run count does not move with tg
per-dispatch bytes sum to catalog; catalog equals disk; 8*bytes/params = sealed EBPW
swiglu vs 1 is graph identity, DIAGNOSTIC_RELATIVE, NOT_FOR_PROMOTION
threshold is incumbent-relative, never the candidate's own score
physical metrics stay null until a protected complete-token receipt
parity_contract: identical tokenizer-bound output ids; any divergence rejects

roles: embed_tokens one row per token, not the table
